findings.recommended_action: Update review.md to reference the actual latest Claude review file (peer_review.final2.claude.md) or generate the missing final3 review and include it.
findings.why: review.md claims See peer_review.final3.claude.md for the final refreshed fingerprint but Glob confirms no final3 file exists. This erodes audit trail integrity.

findings.claim: Evidence maturity field inconsistent between evidence.md (verified) and review bundle (candidate)
findings.recommended_action: Regenerate the review bundle after updating evidence.md maturity, so the bundle metadata matches the canonical evidence ledger.
findings.why: All four entries show Maturity: verified in evidence.md but maturity: candidate in the review bundle JSON. Consumers of the bundle see stale/contradictory maturity metadata.

findings.claim: _lifecycle_target_name argument parser is coupled to setup_run.py flag schema and not forward-compatible
findings.recommended_action: Add a selftest that verifies unknown flags are safely skipped, and document in _lifecycle_target_name docstring which setup_run.py flags it knows about.
findings.why: The hand-rolled positional parser only knows --date and --target. A new value-consuming flag added to setup_run.py would silently break claim binding without any test catching it.

findings.claim: run_gate stop_hook_active early exit swallows all gate evaluations and drift notifications
findings.recommended_action: Document in run_gate header that early sys.exit(0) on stop_hook_active means no gate, drift, or status information is emitted on retry. Consider adding a systemMessage summary before exiting.
findings.why: The early exit at line 226 fires before active_run resolution and Phase 3 drift checks. If a transient issue caused the first block and was resolved before retry, the retry silently passes without informing the operator or re-evaluating the now-resolved state.

findings.claim: No integration test for the full pending-contract-to-pointer chain as a single subprocess flow
findings.recommended_action: Add an end-to-end subprocess test that: (1) UserPromptSubmit writes pending, (2) PreToolUse allows setup_run.py, (3) verifies the pointer points to the new run with the correct consumed contract.
findings.why: Each component is tested in isolation (separate subprocess invocations) but no single test drives the complete hook-to-tool-to-hook chain. The contract between hook evaluation and tool runtime is untested at the integration level.

findings.claim: _control_invocation suffix stripping asymmetry: only one redirect suffix is stripped despite claiming to fold benign fd redirections
findings.recommended_action: Document the single-suffix behavior in the docstring, or use a loop to strip multiple known-safe suffixes. The regex backstop makes it safe but the single-strip semantics are surprising.
findings.why: The break after the first match means only one redirect suffix is handled. 2>&1 2>/dev/null is rejected (not stripped) while 2>/dev/null 2>&1 is accepted. This asymmetry is flagged in every review round and consistently dismissed, but it remains surprising to future maintainers.
